issues.description: Field 'lectureName' has conflicting types in the problem materials: the UML class diagram in problem_statement.md declares 'lectureName' as type int (problem_statement.md lines 63-68), but the textual toString() example in the same problem statement shows lectureName as a String (problem_statement.md lines 36-38) and the reference solution declares the field as String (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 6). This contradiction can confuse students about the correct type to implement and may lead to incorrect implementations that don't match the instructor's intent.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the UML in problem_statement.md to declare lectureName as a String (e.g. "-lectureName: String") to match the example toString output and the solution implementation. Verify and update any other occurrences in the problem statement (UML diagram and descriptive text) so all artifacts consistently treat lectureName as a String.
